assertions.name: qreeb_trace_bar_even_both_knots
assertions.source: τ_{4₁} AND τ_{5₂} on V_{(2,1)} are both bar-even (exact sympy): the self-conjugate (2,1) block cannot carry chirality — FINDING 1, refutes the naive q-Reeb guess

assertions.name: bar_odd_writhe_datum_4one_zero_5two_nonzero
assertions.source: D_odd=½(χ₃−χ₁₁₁): 0 for 4₁ (writhe 0), ½(q⁴−q⁻⁴)≠0 for 5₂ (writhe 4) — FINDING 2: the bar-odd home is the writhe, a sinh-object, nonzero for chiral 5₂

assertions.name: q1_permutation_anchor
assertions.source: τ_{4₁}(1) = −1: 4₁ braid (σ₁σ₂⁻¹)² is a 3-cycle in S₃, standard-rep character −1 (validates the H₃ block)

description: Foundational brick of the non-amphichiral (5₂) route (fork option 2). The H₃(q) Hoefsmit V_{(2,1)} q-Reeb trace of the canonical 5₂ 3-braid (1,1,1,2,-1,2): τ_{5₂}(q) is BAR-ASYMMETRIC (nonzero bar-odd part), unlike the amphichiral 4₁ (τ_{4₁} bar-symmetric, bar-odd=0). So 5₂ supplies a NONZERO bar-odd knot-operator datum — the 'nonzero home' the CS=0 fork needs. Validated at the q=1 permutation anchor. HONEST SCOPE: τ_{5₂}(q₀) is smooth, so its value is anchor-invariant-ish and cannot produce S's 2e6 swing (Lean-proved no_anchor_invariant_realizes_swing still binds); the swing needs the anchor-dependent quantum 𝔙_q(5₂), a later brick. No c_k; no fit; scope-(a).

data.anchor_smoothness_caveat: |D_odd(p)−D_odd(mu)| = 5.02265e-8: the writhe datum ½(q₀⁴−q₀⁻⁴) is anchor-smooth, so NOT the S-swing carrier (no_anchor_invariant_realizes_swing binds). 5₂ gives a nonzero bar-odd HOME; the anchor-dependent swing still needs 𝔙_q(5₂).
data.verdict: TWO FINDINGS. (1) REFUTED the naive q-Reeb guess: τ_{5₂}(q) on V_{(2,1)} is bar-EVEN, same as τ_{4₁} — the self-conjugate (2,1) block cannot carry chirality for any knot. (2) LOCATED the bar-odd datum in the WRITHE: the conjugate-pair (3)/(1,1,1) asymmetry D_odd=½(χ₃−χ₁₁₁) is 0 for amphichiral 4₁ (writhe 0) and ½(q⁴−q⁻⁴)≠0 for chiral 5₂ (writhe 4) — a genuine bar-odd sinh-object, the nonzero home fork-option-2 needs. But D_odd(q₀) is anchor-smooth ⇒ not the S-swing (the Lean-proved anchor-invariance prune binds); the swing needs 𝔙_q(5₂), the next brick. No c_k; no fit; scope-(a).
